How many of you are coming back because of F2P?

The girlfriend and i came back a month or so before the F2P announcement, just to test the waters. We rolled 4 new chars, to work our way towards 50 as we see how many players there were. We were shocked - simply shocked - at how many people there were in lower level zones. PvP Queues never popped, but there were a surprising number of people in all of our leveling experience.

Now, the amount we saw wasn't like release, nor is it like a large healthy MMO - but we also created leveled 2 50s back in November, and there were so many more lowbies this time around. I was very happy with the state of wildstar then - and that was before the f2p announcement.

When f2p was announced, i was sold. The new players in the game indicated to me that WS was going to slowly recover. Even if WS stayed small, it had a chance to be healthy. However, the F2P announcement gave me true faith in Wildstar's future. It showed me that NCSoft and CRB had no immediate plans to close Wildstar. I bought multiple copies (as did my gf) to add to my account; I currently have a paid account through January 2016 haha.

Now, this story is a bit long, but since no one else is posting _(/v/wildstar being a niche Subverse atm)_, i figured i would try to give some scope to the answer. Yes, many are coming back due to F2P, for many reasons. I definitely recommend subbing now for the benefits, and all around to enjoy the experience.
